reasoningChain.evidence: Strengthening the current damage roster before choosing a rescue route supports progression.
The warrior remains a verified active contributor but currently has the weakest weapon among the physical heroes.
The guaranteed level-22 weapon grants 11 physical power, far above the warrior's current level-four weapon with 2 physical power.
The ranger already holds a stronger legendary weapon and the berserker has specialized low-health gear, so the warrior receives the largest obvious active-roster upgrade.
